''See also: [[Heart (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Heart of Nakothi]], also known as the [[Dead Mother's heart]], is a fist-sized, pulsing gray and green organ that serves as a remnant of a [[Great Elder]]. While the [[Dead Mother]] once possessed many such hearts, these organs are characterized by their ability to pump sludge or nutrients into an Elder's massive, decaying body. They possess a powerful, ancient, and malicious intent that can influence the minds of those nearby, often inducing madness or a desire to be remade. The Heart has played a central role in the stability of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]], as it was used by the former Emperor to achieve immortality. However, maintaining this connection required immense willpower to stave off insanity and the influence of [[Nakothi]]. The Heart is also a significant political tool, as possessing it can provide a legitimate claim to the imperial throne. Because of its connection to the [[Dead Mother]], destroying a Heart is extremely dangerous; if released prematurely, its power could trigger the awakening of the [[Great Elder]]. Consequently, these artifacts must be carefully contained or weakened before they can be safely destroyed.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Heart is a valuable object that recently arrived on the island. Located within a crater, this [[gray-green heart]] pulses at the center of a network of veins and tendons. It is a highly sought-after prize for the [[Consultants]], and its discovery has led to conflict as the Emperor's successor fights over the [[Dead Mother]]'s Heart. While [[Calder]] searches for the entity, it is suggested that the Heart may desire to be bonded with a human. As events progress, the object or concept appears to be drawing closer.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Heart is an [[Elder artifacts{{!}}Elder artifact]] consisting of a piece of an Elder's body that has been sought by various clients. Associated with [[Nakothi]], the object is a target for the [[Am’haranai]] to reclaim and is the primary objective of Clayborn's mission to [[Nakothi's island]]. This powerful item has the capacity to overpower [[Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin]]'s seal, transform ancient bodies into [[Children of Nakothi]], and potentially wake the [[Dead Mother]] if its power is released. While the [[Sleepless]] are pleased by its arrival on the island, [[Shera]] seeks to find the object to prevent it from falling into their hands. Ultimately, the Heart disappeared on the island and is believed to have been destroyed.}}
